integrity: All exact finite tests are supplementary to a paper proof. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proof is for the uniform unweighted perfect matching measure on a complete graph with one fixed matching deleted. It establishes pairwise edge-indicator covariances, not negative association, weighted analogues, or a general complete multipartite result. Source priority remains subject to external verification; independent validation not performed.
title: Complete sign law for edge-pair correlations in deranged perfect matchings
